subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should `sessions.files.get` remain under `operator.read` while expanding from transcript-touched files to any fs-safe in-workspace file for the Control UI viewer?
rationale: The requested UX is clear, but it deliberately changes the Gateway file-content read boundary and the live issue is protected by the `maintainer` label, so automation should not decide the authorization contract.

options.title: Approve bounded in-root reads after PR fixes
options.body: Keep the requested product direction, require the candidate PR to fix its review blockers, and document or test that `operator.read` intentionally covers these workspace file contents.

options.title: Split chat links from read-scope expansion
options.body: Land file-link rendering and transcript-touched previews first, then decide workspace-wide content preview in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Keep transcript-only file content reads
options.body: Preserve the current narrower file-content boundary and leave browser-only workspace files as browse/copy-only until a different authorization shape exists.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded in-root reads after PR fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the requested product direction, require the candidate PR to fix its review blockers, and document or test that `operator.read` intentionally covers these workspace file contents.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected request, authored the candidate implementation, and are the clearest product-direction owner for the UX/read-boundary choice.
